text:
DeployBot: kicking off staged rollout service=inference-api model=v2.9.0 cohort=EMEA initial=2% planned-bump=12% at +12m `/deploy start --staged=2% --bump=12%`
Nora: quick note: includes lc-tokenizer fix and small kvcache change. Suggest conservative initial 2% then evaluate token-truncation and kvcache hit.
Dex: agree. Can we pin to driver-stable for the canary? Last week's warmstart variance was on mixed drivers.
Infra: pin applied to driver-stable; hotstart-delay=6s.
June (oncall): holding until auth & p99 stable for 5m. If auth.fail.delta >0.4% or p99 > baseline+120ms -> stop.
DeployBot: canary active at 2%. Monitoring hooks: auth.fail, latency.p99, tokenizer.truncation, kvcache.hitrate.
MetricsBot: auth.fail delta=0.0% latency.p99 +8ms tokenizer.truncation=0.0% kvcache.hitrate -0.5%
Nora: tokenization looks fine; small kvcache dip expected, recommended soak 12m before bump.
June (oncall): holding for soak. Will thumbs-up to bump if no p99 tail appears.
DeployBot: bump scheduled to 12% after soak. `/deploy edit --soak=12m --bump=12%`
MetricsBot: at +9m pre-bump kvcache.hitrate stable -0.6% auth still green
DeployBot: bumping to 12% now `/deploy bump --staged=12%`
MetricsBot: post-bump: latency.p99 +210ms (threshold 120ms), request.5xx jumped to 0.9% (threshold 0.5%)
June (oncall): calling stop. p99 tail and 5xx exceed thresholds. Initiating rollback to v2.8.7.
Dex: concur. Stop and rollback now.
DeployBot: rollback initiated `/deploy rollback --service=inference-api --to=model=v2.8.7`
Infra: scaling down v2.9.0, reinstating v2.8.7; expect ~50s warmstart bleed.
MetricsBot: post-rollback: latency.p99 back to +9ms request.5xx 0.03%
Nora: will open PR to separate kvcache change from tokenizer fix and run extended p99 soak in staging.
June (oncall): adding runbook snippet for emergency rollback: `/deploy rollback --service=inference-api --to=model=v2.8.7`
DeployBot: automation closing thread after rollback complete. Reopen if follow-ups.
